title: Code length
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Its code length at parameters $n,s$ is $W(N)(2s+1)+w_P(n)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
caveat: The meanings of $W(N)$ and $w_P(n)$ are not supplied in the payload, so they can only be named as machine and parameter quantities.
